Focus-specific listing copy — what translates differently

Focus-forward listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Focus workflows — not a literal paste of US marketing:

  • 专注模式 (Focus mode) vs 专注筛选 (Focus Filter) — Apple’s Chinese UI uses 专注模式 for mode names and 专注筛选 for filter configuration. A Works with Focus badge frame needs 专注模式-friendly phrasing; a filter-picker frame may use 专注筛选 when accurate.
  • 勿扰模式 (Do Not Disturb) — when your marketing shows DND schedules or silence exceptions, zh-Hans copy should use 勿扰模式 vocabulary buyers recognize — not a generic “quiet mode” translation.
  • Mode-accurate claims — if you ship a Work Focus filter only, zh-Hans copy should say 在工作专注模式下可用 — not promise Sleep or Driving Focus unless your binary supports those modes.
  • Subtitle and keyword packing — the 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Focus-relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords guide for field mechanics.
  • Screenshot captions on Focus frames — gallery frames that show filter pickers or allowlist sheets need one-line zh-Hans captions — “在专注模式下仅显示重要通知” not “Allow during Focus” burned into the product page story.

Common mistakes on Focus Filter zh-Hans listings

  • Assuming Focus Filter capability localizes automatically — SetFocusFilterIntent wired in Xcode; zh-Hans row never added or left blank
  • Only translating the description — subtitle, keywords, and Focus screenshot caption lines still English
  • Claiming every Focus mode when you ship one filter — zh-Hans copy promises Sleep and Personal Focus when your binary only registers a Work filter
  • Conflating Focus Filters with App Intents — listing says “Siri and Shortcuts” when the product story is Focus allowlist behavior, not voice automation
  • English Works with Focus on zh-Hans screenshots — Connect caption fields are Chinese but burned-in badges on PNG exports are still Latin
  • Calling Focus Filters “widgets” or “controls” — buyers searching for 小组件 or 控制中心 expect different surfaces; mislabeling Focus picker UI confuses the feature story
  • What's New still English after Focus Filter launch — see What's New in Simplified Chinese when Focus support shipped in a recent version
  • Literal 翻译腔 on Focus jargon — awkward translations of “Focus Filter” or “Allow during Focus” that native readers do not use in App Store copy

What good zh-Hans Focus Filter listing copy looks like

Listing fields should name the Focus surfaces you actually ship — aligned with your screenshot order:

  • Voice consistency — same 你/您 choice as your description across overlay lines and promotional text

App name and subtitle are each up to 30 characters on the zh-Hans row. The keyword field allows up to 100 characters. Description and screenshot caption lines have longer limits — see Chinese character limits guide for Connect caps.
